info.name: Chatbot API
info.description: HTTP collection for the canonical Sample Chatbot server backend. Covers auth, conversations, messages, AI SDK routes, model-usage analytics, documents, planning, providers, model config, MCP, skills, client devices, and widget connection token minting. WebSocket-only flows are documented in README but excluded here.
